@comment: Preflight from a NON-allowlisted origin. The property under test is the ABSENCE of every Access-Control-Allow-* header: an arbitrary site must never be granted a credentialed cross-origin read. The preflight middleware declines to answer, so gin's HandleMethodNotAllowed replies 405 + Allow for a method this endpoint does not serve — the correct HTTP answer, and equally unusable to the browser. (Upstream KrakenD's cors service plugin answered 204 with a wildcard here; that plugin is deliberately not wired — routes.go owns the ONE CORS policy.)
